name: conventions
description: Powercademy's living conventions for Power Platform delivery — the rules applied before and while building: Dataverse schema and solution discipline, the Power Automate, PCF and model-driven UX lessons that cost hours once, and the right tool for each job (purpose-built tools, then SDK / Web API / CLI, browser automation only where nothing else reaches). Each rule carries its reasoning; the lists grow with every corrected mistake.
